control_plane.name: CP0_BASE_CONTROL_PLANE
control_plane.purpose: 전역 권위, routing, registry, generated view, partition contract와 cross-part 통합을 단일 쓰기 지점으로 유지한다.
change_protocol: Coordinator may fix validated cross-Part or CP0 findings directly with CROSS_PART_CHANGE semantic attribution
Different Part ownership alone is not a write barrier
Open PR state alone is not active-worker evidence; require current owner evidence before protecting a workstream

When the user confirms CURRENT_COORDINATOR_CHAT is the only active worker, classify unresolved open PRs and use COORDINATOR_TAKEOVER, READY_TO_FINISH, SUPERSEDED_DUPLICATE, STALE_BACKLOG, or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL as appropriate
Only ACTIVE_OTHER_WORKER workstreams are mutation-protected unless the user explicitly authorizes takeover
CROSS_PART_CHANGE_REQUEST is reserved for real authority/evidence/current-owner blockers
Generated artifacts are rebuilt from authority rather than hand-edited
Exact-head CI and post-merge GitHub/Notion readback are required

parts.name: Project Planning, Operations & Notion
parts.purpose: 요청 intake부터 작업계약, 프로젝트 운영, 설계문서, handoff, 장기 continuity, 사람용 학습/Notion 흐름을 최적화한다.
revisit_conditions: Notion workspace 구조가 materially 변경됨
Codex/executor 권위가 새 플랫폼으로 바뀜
P01 cross-part request가 반복적으로 P02/P03에 집중됨

discovery_questions: Notion/project operating systems that reduce duplicate decisions and handoff loss
human-facing documentation patterns that preserve one machine/runtime truth
agent instruction/context patterns that reduce repeated clarification and unnecessary executor hops

parts.name: Skill Governance, Canon Freshness & Legacy
parts.purpose: Skill 생명주기, 정본 신선도, Base 변경제안, 단순화, stale/legacy 흡수·archive·삭제를 최적화한다.
read_only_dependencies: all Part Skill bodies as audit inputs
acceptance_criteria: legacy source의 unique material destination 명시
revisit_conditions: Skill 책임·trigger·context가 중복되어 실제 routing/maintenance 비용이 증가
legacy cleanup backlog가 독립 작업량으로 커짐
reference freshness false positive/negative가 반복됨

discovery_questions: skill consolidation, progressive disclosure, routing precision and evaluation
deprecation/legacy retirement patterns that preserve unique knowledge before deletion
canonical-reference freshness and stale-reference detection practices

parts.name: Adversarial Quality, Refactoring & Git Integrity
parts.purpose: 적대적 검토, 계약보존 리팩터링, Git 동기화와 변경 무결성을 최적화하되 실제 실행 증거 owner는 P07과 분리한다.
read_only_dependencies: all Part diffs as adversarial inputs
revisit_conditions: review loop가 과도한 churn을 만듦
Git concurrency failure가 반복됨
P03/P07 evidence 책임 경계가 반복적으로 모호해짐

discovery_questions: adversarial review and defect-finding methods that avoid performative checklist loops
contract-preserving refactoring and semantic regression detection
Git/worktree/PR concurrency and exact-head integration safety

parts.name: Game Design, Core, Player Research & Vertical Slice
parts.purpose: 게임 컨셉·코어·기능·플레이어 가치·밸런스·Vertical Slice의 기획 품질과 검증 가능성을 최적화한다.
acceptance_criteria: 기능 수보다 플레이어 감정/선택/보상 가치가 우선
최소 3개 실질 대안과 benchmark trade study 존재
프로젝트 고유 규칙과 Base 공용 원리가 분리
revisit_conditions: 게임 설계 Skill 책임·trigger가 겹치거나 context/routing 비용이 materially 증가
P04가 아트/런타임 구현까지 반복 침범
다른 장르의 기획 계약이 현재 core model과 충돌

discovery_questions: player motivation, choice, reward, memory and first-impression evidence
vertical-slice and prototype validation practices for small teams
game balance, difficulty, onboarding and player-research methods with usable evidence

parts.name: Art, UX/UI & Visual Assets
parts.purpose: 아트 방향, 이미지 생성/검수, UX/UI, 시각 자산 재사용과 Notion visual workflow를 최적화하고 폐기된 시각 Tool/HTML 권위를 제거한다.
acceptance_criteria: AI 티 감소·일관성·가독성 검수 계약 보존
시각이 중요한 PoC는 승인 visual 입력을 소비
고유 기능 흡수 전 파괴적 삭제 0
revisit_conditions: 새 시각 workspace가 사용자 승인으로 도입됨
Notion visual workflow가 성능/기능 blocker가 됨
로컬 시각 Tool에 아직 대체 불가능 unique capability가 확인됨

discovery_questions: art direction and visual-consistency pipelines that reduce synthetic/AI-looking artifacts
game UX/UI readability, accessibility and first-impression evaluation
image-to-structured-layer/reusable-asset workflows and visual provenance management

parts.name: Godot, Runtime & Technical Toolchain
parts.purpose: Godot 저작/실행/디버깅, addon/toolchain, runtime adapter와 repository-native runtime evidence boundary를 최적화한다.
important_rules: HiGodot single authoring authority when adopted
acceptance_criteria: addon은 실제 consumer가 있을 때만 유지
retired QA/local management surface를 active route로 재도입 0
revisit_conditions: Godot major/minor toolchain 변경
HiGodot authority 정책 변경
retired local QA/tool code consumer 0이 확인되어 physical retirement task가 안전해짐

discovery_questions: current Godot engine/runtime/debugging guidance and regressions
addon/plugin evaluation, editor tooling and local execution reliability
repository-native runtime evidence patterns that avoid a second management authority

parts.name: Platform, Release & Execution Validation
parts.purpose: 실제 diff/실행 증거 검증과 플랫폼·권리·빌드·배포·backend·DRM·release 준비를 하나의 delivery evidence 책임으로 최적화한다.
read_only_dependencies: P01 project-operation evidence templates: templates/project-operations/** (read-only semantic dependency)
important_rules: runtime/build proof separate from planning approval
Android deferred until approved release stage where applicable
acceptance_criteria: 주요 완료 주장에 evidence locator 존재
revisit_conditions: 출시 플랫폼 추가
backend/provider 전략 변경
P07 validation skill이 P03와 반복적으로 결합되어 독립성이 사라짐

discovery_questions: platform/store/build/release requirements and official policy changes
evidence-led validation, accessibility/performance/release readiness practices
backend, entitlement, DRM, rights and distribution practices appropriate for small games

parts.name: AI Operations & External Executors
parts.purpose: AI instruction/context, model/cost/source research, DeepSeek/worktree와 외부 executor 운영을 최적화한다.
acceptance_criteria: 외부 executor가 프로젝트 정본을 다시 읽음

AI routing이 독립 시스템으로 커져 P08 분할이 필요

discovery_questions: current agent/context/prompt/eval patterns that reduce tool and skill overload
model routing and cost-control practices that preserve quality without new paid dependencies
safe external-executor/worktree patterns for long-running coding tasks

parts.name: Content, Narrative & Publication
parts.purpose: 연재소설, 게임 서사/캐릭터/voice와 게임개발 YouTube 등 외부 콘텐츠 제작·발행 흐름을 최적화한다.
important_rules: content output is not runtime implementation proof
acceptance_criteria: 프로젝트 고유 서사가 Base 공용 정본으로 오염되지 않음
revisit_conditions: 콘텐츠 채널이 추가되어 publication 책임이 커짐
서사 Skill 수가 materially 증가
게임 서사와 일반 소설 계약이 더 이상 같은 Part에서 관리하기 어려움

discovery_questions: serial-fiction revision, character voice and continuity methods
interactive narrative, mystery/clue and worldbuilding practices with audience evidence
game-development YouTube packaging, script, edit and analytics practices without copying expression

retirement_targets.rule: UNIQUE material only -> Notion/repository -> readback -> active consumer 0 -> remove
absorb unique visual principles/provenance only; no active authority
absorb unique human-view capability into Notion then remove active route
absorb unique concepts into current owners; active/default Tool Hub route remains retired
absorb evidence vocabulary/contracts into REPOSITORY_NATIVE_EVIDENCE_CAPTURE; retire active route; physical deletion only after consumer/readback safety

ordered_steps: Run P01 through P09 sequentially in CURRENT_COORDINATOR_CHAT
Repin latest main between Part checkpoints
Fix validated cross-Part/CP0 findings directly when no protected active-workstream blocker exists
Reconcile self-contained Notion Base/Project Homes from merged facts
Run repository-wide regression and required CI
Run at least 5 true full-scope adversarial loops and continue until CLEAN_REVIEW_EXIT
integration.rollback: Revert integration commit/PR; Part PRs remain independently auditable and can be reverted by Part boundary. Never roll back unrelated workstreams.

revisit_conditions: Skill routing/ownership conflict materially increases despite consolidation
median cross-part requests > 3 per Part optimization
any single Part repeatedly exceeds practical GPT context
two or more Parts repeatedly edit the same semantic owner through Integration
new major product domain or engine is added
Notion/GitHub authority model materially changes
dynamic dependency clustering can preserve stable Part IDs and materially reduce conflicts

rules: Every completed Part work records one checkpoint, including NO_NEW_REUSABLE_LESSON when appropriate
Project-specific lessons stay project-specific unless the Base promotion gate is satisfied
External discovery remains UNVERIFIED_DISCOVERY until original-source review and evidence disposition
New source count is not a success metric; decision improvement and reproducibility are
Source Queue preparation does not imply research completion or learning completion

active_workstream_detection.rule: PR state is metadata. Classify actual current ownership before deciding whether mutation is forbidden.
